parts.label: a
parts.technique: Moments of forces on a rigid rod resting on two supports
parts.reason: M9.1 explicitly covers moments in simple static contexts including rods/beams on supports.

parts.label: b

parts.reason: Same moments topic as (a), extended; fully covered by M9.1.

parts.label: a
parts.reason: Requires impulse (I = mv - mu); 'impulse' is explicitly listed as a concept no 9MA0 M-statement covers, making this OUT despite being simple arithmetic.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Conservation of linear momentum (PCLM) in a collision
parts.reason: Requires principle of conservation of momentum, not mentioned in any M6-M9 statement; also depends on impulse-derived speed from (a). Both momentum and impulse are absent from spec statements.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Impulse exerted by floor on ball
parts.reason: Requires impulse (I = m(v-u)); 'impulse' is an explicitly excluded/unmentioned concept, so OUT.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: suvat to find maximum height under gravity
parts.reason: Uses given rebound speed 7 m/s (not dependent on the impulse calculation of part (a)) with v^2=u^2+2as; covered by M7.3 constant acceleration formulae and M8.3 motion under gravity.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: suvat/quadratic to find time at given height, motion under gravity
parts.reason: Uses given speed 7 m/s and constant acceleration formulae to solve quadratic in t; standard M7.3/M8.3 application, does not depend on part (a) impulse answer.

parts.reason: Covered by M7.2 (interpretation of velocity-time graphs) and M7.3 (constant acceleration).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Distance travelled via area under v-t graph / suvat, solving for time
parts.reason: Uses M7.2 (area under graph = distance) and M7.3 (constant acceleration formulae) to equate distances and solve for T.

parts.reason: Same vector kinematics topic, M7.3, standard component equating.

parts.reason: Continuation of resultant-force problem, still M8.5.
